tools.name: discover
tools.description: Describe this host and every plugin, including the setup prompt and the setup and validate commands.

tools.name: mesh.list
tools.description: List mesh tools, the repos that declared them, and the Cloudflare Access limits agents must stay inside.

tools.name: mesh.lsp
tools.description: Return the language servers declared for this repository.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check the catalog, mesh, repos, and Cloudflare files. This repo has no GitHub workflows. Mirrored repos still follow the runner rule. Omit level for strict.

tools.name: repos
tools.description: Repo list and sync interval from github-repos/config. Does not fetch.

tools.name: explore
tools.description: Show this checkout and each mirrored repo: path, HEAD, dirty, and top-level names. Does not fetch.

tools.name: sync
tools.description: Mirror github-repos/config, then lock the reference tree read-only.

tools.name: prove
tools.description: Container proof. Requires a model id. Does not mount this machine's weights or tokens.

tools.name: attach-plan
tools.description: Print one mount of this home for an Apple container and a macOS sandbox share. Does not start a guest.

tools.name: attach-run
tools.description: Start an Apple container with this home attached. The image is an argument. A filter JSON selects models and skills.

tools.name: attach-macos
tools.description: Put this home on one macOS sandbox share. Does not start the VM.

tools.name: adopt
tools.description: Move an older layout into the self-hosted home. The old path is left absent.

tools.name: flake
tools.description: Run nix flake check for this checkout. That is the Nix check of every plugin package.

tools.name: mesh.skill
tools.description: Return one skill by name. The name is a skill id, not a path.

tools.name: events.webhooks
tools.description: Return the one event schema and each plugin webhook. Watch GET /events and filter with plugin, type, and name.

tools.name: events.history
tools.description: Read the event log. Filter with plugin, type, name, and since. This is the history of every plugin.

tools.name: events.describe
tools.description: Describe this system from the event log. A plugin is ok when every latest event is ok.

tools.name: events.workflow
tools.description: Record a ci workflow event for one plugin. detail is started, ok, or error. The event stores no other text.
